About RenderPop

What is RenderPop?

A browser-based workspace for making AI images and videos from prompts or source media.

RenderPop lets you create images from text or a source photo, then make videos from prompts or images. You can try Fast image generation without signing in. Video creation and reference uploads require an account and credits.

The creation workspace keeps image and video tools together. Pick the mode that fits the job, add a prompt or source image, and review the credit requirement before you generate.

FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about RenderPop's photorealistic AI portrait & video engine.

Is RenderPop AI free to try?+

Visitors can try Fast image generation without signing in. Creating videos and using credit-based features requires a signed-in account.

Do I need to sign in to create AI videos?+

Yes. You can explore the site and try Fast image generation without signing in, while AI video and dance video creation require an account and credits.

What can I create with RenderPop?+

You can create AI images from prompts or source photos, generate AI videos, and turn an image into a video from the same workspace.

Can I turn a photo into a video?+

Yes. Upload an image in the creation workspace to use image-to-video generation. Video creation requires signing in and uses credits.

How does the AI Dance Video tool work?+

Choose a dance template or upload a reference video, add a photo you are authorized to use, and generate a motion-controlled video with credits.

Can I animate a still portrait photo into a video clip?+

Yes. Add a still image in the creation workspace to create an image-to-video generation with a signed-in account and credits.

How do credits work for video and Dance tools?+

Video and Dance generation use credits. The creation screen shows the required credits before you start.

What source media can I upload?+

Image and video tools list their supported file types and size limits in the upload controls. Use media you have permission to use.

Can I use my own video as a motion reference?+

Yes. On the Dance page, you can upload an authorized reference video and pair it with an authorized photo.

Can I share a generated result?+

Review the result and make sure you have the right to use the source material before you share it on another platform.

Do unused monthly subscription credits roll over?+

Yes. Active subscription credits roll over into the next billing cycle, up to twice your plan's monthly allocation.

What content should I avoid?+

Do not upload media you do not have permission to use or create non-consensual and otherwise prohibited content.

What makes a good source photo for Dance?+

Use a clear, well-lit photo with one person and a visible face and body.

Why does the same prompt produce different variations?+

AI generation includes randomness, so the same prompt can produce different results. That can help when you want to explore several directions.

How do I buy credits?+

Sign in, then open the pricing page to view memberships and credit packs.

Feature SpotlightWhat can I do before I sign in?+

You can explore the site and try Fast image generation. Sign in before using video, Dance, or reference-upload tools.

什么是 RenderPop？

基于浏览器的工作区，用于根据提示或源媒体制作 AI 图像和视频。

RenderPop 允许您从文本或源照片创建图像，然后根据提示或图像制作视频。 您可以在不登录的情况下尝试快速生成图像。 视频创建和参考上传需要帐户和积分。

FAQ

常见问题解答

关于 RenderPop 的真实感 AI 肖像和视频引擎，您需要了解的一切。

Is RenderPop AI free to try?+

访客无需登录即可尝试快速图像生成。 创建视频和使用基于信用的功能需要登录帐户。

Do I need to sign in to create AI videos?+

是的。 您可以探索该网站并尝试快速生成图像而无需登录，而人工智能视频和舞蹈视频创建则需要帐户和积分。

What can I create with RenderPop?+

您可以根据提示或源照片创建 AI 图像、生成 AI 视频以及从同一工作区将图像转换为视频。

Can I turn a photo into a video?+

是的。 在创建工作区中上传图像以使用图像到视频生成。 视频创作需要登录并使用积分。

How does the AI Dance Video tool work?+

选择舞蹈模板或上传参考视频，添加您有权使用的照片，并生成带有制作人员的动作控制视频。

Can I animate a still portrait photo into a video clip?+

是的。 在创建工作区中添加静态图像，以使用登录帐户和制作人员来创建图像到视频的生成。

How do credits work for video and Dance tools?+

视频和舞蹈生成使用学分。 在开始之前，创建屏幕会显示所需的积分。

What source media can I upload?+

图像和视频工具在上传控件中列出了其支持的文件类型和大小限制。 使用您有权使用的媒体。

Can I use my own video as a motion reference?+

是的。 在舞蹈页面上，您可以上传授权参考视频并将其与授权照片配对。

Can I share a generated result?+

查看结果并确保您有权使用源材料，然后再将其共享到其他平台。

Do unused monthly subscription credits roll over?+

是的。 有效订阅积分可转入下一个计费周期，最多可达计划每月分配额的两倍。

What content should I avoid?+

请勿上传您无权使用的媒体或创建未经同意的内容和其他禁止的内容。

What makes a good source photo for Dance?+

使用一张清晰、光线充足的照片，其中有一个人以及清晰的脸部和身体。

Why does the same prompt produce different variations?+

AI生成具有随机性，因此相同的提示可能会产生不同的结果。 当您想探索多个方向时，这会有所帮助。

How do I buy credits?+

登录，然后打开定价页面以查看会员资格和积分包。

Feature SpotlightWhat can I do before I sign in?+

您可以浏览该网站并尝试快速图像生成。 使用视频、舞蹈或参考上传工具之前请先登录。
